From classroom to career

  1. 190 daysTraining, live projects and a channel of your own
  2. 2Top ten studentsA three-month internship at PICHCHRAPA production house, with travel allowance
  3. 3Top two or threeA salaried position at PICHCHRAPA after six months

Three crafts, one programme

What do you want to become in cinema?

All three tracks run for 90 days. The first month is shared; after that each student trains in depth in their own craft.

  • ActorActingFilm, web series, television or your own digital stage: learn to be natural and truthful in front of the camera.
    • Foundations of Stanislavski, Stella Adler and Meisner
    • Emotional Flow Engine (Yogesh CineAct): shifting and measuring emotion
    • Character building, scene work and command of dialogue
    • Dance, music and action basics for the screen
    Full curriculum
  • DirectorDirectionFrom story to camera: learn to create your own short film, web series or digital show.
    • Story and screenplay: Concept, Conflict, Climax, Resolution
    • Shot breakdown, storyboards and lenses
    • Blocking and working with actors
    • Multi-camera shooting: one scene, many cameras
    Full curriculum
  • EditorEditingEditing for film, web series and digital platforms: the craft every creator needs today.
    • DaVinci Resolve from the ground up: cuts, trims and the timeline
    • Multi-camera sync and editing
    • The rhythm of comedy and drama: when to cut, when to hold
    • Sound clean-up, music and ambience
    Full curriculum

The 90-day journey

Three months, three stages

  1. Month 1

    In front of the camera

    For every student

    A director or editor first learns to see the camera through an actor's eyes. That is why the first month is acting, for everyone.

    • Yogesh CineAct: the four pillars of an actor, Believing, Respect, Seriousness, Enjoying
    • Observation System: Micro, Nano, Combination and Live Observation
    • The Indian roots of acting: Natyashastra and the nine rasas
    • Body, voice, diction and microphone technique
    • Expression, dialogue and presence on camera
    • Improvisation: building scenes without a script
    • Shooting on a phone and the basics of Reels and Shorts
  2. Month 2

    Depth in your craft

    Actor, Director or Editor

    In the second month each student trains in detail in the craft they have chosen.

    ActorFoundations of Stanislavski, Stella Adler and Meisner · Emotional Flow Engine (Yogesh CineAct): shifting and measuring emotion · Character building, scene work and command of dialogueDirectorStory and screenplay: Concept, Conflict, Climax, Resolution · Shot breakdown, storyboards and lenses · Blocking and working with actorsEditorDaVinci Resolve from the ground up: cuts, trims and the timeline · Multi-camera sync and editing · The rhythm of comedy and drama: when to cut, when to hold
  3. Month 3

    On a real set

    Live projects

    The third month belongs to the set, not the classroom. Every student works on a real production and leaves with a portfolio.

    • Real shoots on PICHCHRAPA web series and digital productions
    • Actor: performance on camera, showreel and portfolio photoshoot
    • Director: directing an episode or a short film
    • Editor: editing and publishing real episodes
    • Everyone: launching and running a YouTube or Instagram channel

All classes

Every student is also a creator

A complete grounding in digital media

Many artists no longer wait for a film; they build their own stage. So every CINEKAR student, whatever their craft, is trained to create and publish on YouTube and Instagram.

How to open strongly, how to tell a story, how to shoot well on a phone and how to stay consistent: all of it is learnt in 90 days, on the student's own channel.

A case in point: every actor in the comedy series Gapistaan (Gen Gap) trained at this academy, and the series is shot using the same method.

Mentorship

Founders of the academy

Yogesh Mishrra

Founder and Chief Mentor

Film director and a trusted mentor in camera acting. Shaped by the theatre environments of the Bharatendu Natya Academy and the National School of Drama, he trained under theatre maestro Surya Mohan Kulshreshtha.

He has directed films such as Dabang Sarkar and Vidyapeeth and has headed post-production on more than 15 feature films. He has taught acting for over 15 years, and Yogesh CineAct is his own method.

He is also the creator and director of the comedy series Gapistaan (Gen Gap), whose entire cast trained at this academy.

IMDbYogesh CineActGapistaan

Dinesh Kumar Sahgal

Co-founder

Over 30 years of leadership across government, film, media and entertainment. As Deputy Director in the Information and Public Relations Department and at Film Bandhu, Government of Uttar Pradesh, he helped establish the state as a major filming destination.

He holds an M.Sc. in Mathematics, a B.Ed. and a postgraduate diploma in computer science, with further training in multimedia and theatre. He joined the academy as co-founder in 2026.

Frequently asked questions

How long is the CINEKAR programme?

90 days. The first month is acting for everyone, the second is your chosen craft (Actor, Director or Editor) and the third is a live project.

What is the fee?

The programme fee is ₹50,000. In two instalments it is ₹27,500 + ₹27,500. A merit scholarship of up to 20% is awarded on the basis of the selection audition.

What is the selection audition?

A brief audition and conversation at the academy, so that we understand your interest and preparation. Scholarships are decided on this basis.

Is there a degree or age requirement?

No degree is required. Anyone aged 16 or above may apply.

What opportunities follow the programme?

The top ten students of every batch receive a three-month internship at PICHCHRAPA production house with travel allowance, after which the top two or three are offered salaried positions. Other students receive guidance on auditions and projects.

Why do directors and editors also learn acting?

Because the best directors and editors understand actors. The first month gives everyone a feel for the camera, character and performance.

Is digital creator training included?

Yes. Every student launches a channel within the 90 days and learns creation, shooting, editing and consistent publishing on it.

Can I learn from home?

CINEKAR is a classroom and on-set programme. For learning from home we offer a separate online acting course.
